wren.title: Punt
wren.style: Mixed Martial Arts · Look See Do

L1.note: Fast high check. Into Cross, a special, or the throw on hit.

L2.note: Second hit (high). Into the elbow, a special, or the takedown.

L3.note: String ender. Pushes back; punishable up close on block.

JL.note: Overhead coming down: beats a crouching guard. Deep, it combos.

JH.note: Flying kick. Overhead coming down; deep, it leads into a combo.

H.note: Long high kick (ducked by a crouch). Special-cancel on hit.

FH.note: Advancing spin with big pushback; safe at tip range.

S.note: Signature. Slow, airborne, devastating; punishable if blocked.

FS.note: Travelling jump kick: an overhead. Ends strings; knocks down.

BS.note: Full gauge: more strike damage, half damage from flame for 8 s.

T.note: Beats any guard up close. After a hit it can't be escaped.

U.note: Anti-air: rises under jump-ins and launches. Risky if blocked.

CL.note: Low: block it crouching. A quick poke from the crouch.

DF.note: Rolls through strikes and past the opponent.

L1.note: Fast high jab. Into the elbow, a special, or the throw on hit.

L2.note: Stepping elbow (high). Into the knee, a special, or the clinch trip.

JL.note: Elbow coming down: an overhead. Deep, it combos on landing.

JH.note: Jumping knee. Overhead coming down; deep, it leads into a combo.

H.note: Muay Thai roundhouse to the body. Special-cancel on hit.

FH.note: Teep. Long reach, huge pushback; controls space.

S.note: Leaping flame elbow: an overhead. Knocks down.

FS.note: Flying knee with flame. Ends light strings; knocks down.

BS.note: Half gauge: invulnerable flame burst. Heavily punishable if blocked.

T.note: Beats any guard up close. After a hit it can't be escaped.

U.note: Anti-air: rises under jump-ins and launches. Risky if blocked.

CL.note: Low: block it crouching. Pushes the opponent away.

DF.note: Rolls through strikes and past the opponent.

DB.note: Quick retreating roll. Recovery is punishable.
